set.body:
Problem. ScalaFIM a3ee73b's mvpa module depends on Alder aa998f8 (applicationJVM, preprocessJVM, tuneJVM), and the root aggregates mvpa, so every build that references ScalaFIM loads Alder's build, including consumers that never use mvpa. Alder's build.sbt (aa998f8 and main 38c8cc8, lines 40, 52 and 56) declares file("../resample4s"), file("../gale") and file("../linop4s"). java.io.File resolves these against the sbt process's working directory, not Alder's checkout. From ScalaFIM's own checkout they silently bind the mutable sibling developer repositories; from any other directory the load fails. PLS Neuro consumer evidence: "Invalid build URI (no handler available): file:/Users/bbuchsbaum/code/scala/plsneuro-fixtures/repin-a3ee73b/gale/" (plsneuro-fixtures/repin-a3ee73b/check-1.log). Alder's data JVM/JS/Native modules also switch between the sibling source and a mutable 0.1.0-SNAPSHOT by testing file("../resample4s").isDirectory. docs/architecture/mvpa-alder-boundary.md already records the limitation.

Consumer workaround, local candidate only. PLS Neuro's declared candidate patch on a3ee73b (sha256 bab79f11e8cf21bd7a48ca8da953d6972bba014429e5ea14fa99d5c5706ca033) makes ScalaFIM's Alder load opt-in (-Dscalafim.alder.enabled=true, implied by -Dscalafim.alder.build) and removes mvpa and the examples built on it from root aggregation. It is not proposed natively: it would break ScalaFIM's defaults, because the compileAll, testAll and examples aliases name mvpaJVM and atlasExamplesJVM (build.sbt 1116-1119), benchmarks/mvpa-jvm depends on mvpaJVM (922), and root test would drop mvpa.

Proposed native fix, in Alder's build.sbt, so that ScalaFIM needs no aggregation change:
1. Select sibling builds explicitly, never from the working directory:
   def sourceBuild(name: String): Option[URI] = sys.props.get(s"alder.$name.build").map(path => file(path).getCanonicalFile.toURI)
2. Resample4s: lazy val resample4sRevision = "6bc4172a966c92f1b06811eac64ac2bada9fef9b"; resample4sBuild = sourceBuild("resample4s").getOrElse(uri(s"https://github.com/canardlapin/resample4s.git#$resample4sRevision")). The data modules always depend on those source projects; drop the isDirectory probe and the 0.1.0-SNAPSHOT fallback.
3. Gale: pin an exact revision with the same override (ScalaFIM's admitted clean-composite court used d55fe2f97196a76ab7879e1a12f1e92403aeba06).
4. Linop4s has no canonical public remote: define ridge-linop4s, ridge-gale's test->compile edge on it, their root-aggregate entries and the MiMa/TASTy-MiMa aliases that name ridgeLinop4sJVM only when -Dalder.linop4s.build is supplied, and fail fast with the reason otherwise.
ScalaFIM then bumps its Alder pin; where one Gale or Resample4s tree must be shared, its build can forward scalafim.gale.build and scalafim.resample4s.build to the alder.* properties.

Acceptance: Alder and ScalaFIM load and compile their default aggregates from a directory with no sibling checkouts; ScalaFIM's aliases and root aggregation are unchanged; the clean local-composite mode uses explicit properties only. The implementation belongs in Alder; this issue tracks ScalaFIM's pin bump and consumer adoption.

Consumer: PLS Neuro bd-01M28CQ2K3GCCSF0H3B40KFDPD, branch repin/scalafim-a3ee73b, note docs/verification/scalafim-a3ee73b-repin.md.
set.title: Consumers load Alder, whose build discovers ../gale, ../resample4s and ../linop4s from the working directory
